patch.summary: Wati cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Wati pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 7-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data

blocks.heading: Wati cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Wati against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 7-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, WhatsApp Business) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Platform subscription is only part of the bill — Meta per-message charges vary by template category and recipient country. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Ecommerce and D2C teams that sell and support on WhatsApp requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Platform subscription is only part of the bill — Meta per-message charges vary by template category and recipient country

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Platform subscription is only part of the bill — Meta per-message charges vary by template category and recipient country

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Growth includes 3 users and does not allow additional users at all

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Additional users cost list pricenth on Pro and list pricenth on Business

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: HubSpot integration starts on Pro and Salesforce on Business; Growth has only 2 integrations

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Platform-fee dollars render by region on the pricing page — treat published bands as unconfirmed

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Wati on identical constraints.
